name: midi_play_switch
comment: sceMidi import named by its error strings: play (1) or stop (0) a MIDI port.

name: midi_set_location
comment: sceMidi import named by its error string: set a MIDI port's play location.

name: hsyn_load
comment: Hybrid-synth import: load bank (module, port, SPU address, header address, bank index); its failure prints sceHSyn_Load port error.

name: hsyn_set_volume
comment: Hybrid-synth import used by sndbase_set_port_volume with (module, port, volume).

name: sndbase_rpc_dispatch
comment: Dispatch EE sound commands by command & 0xFFF0 with the low nibble as slot (s0): 0x8010 initialize, 0x8100 MIDI input buffer for a port, 0x9050 bind bank, 0xA0 port parameter, 0xB0 port volume, MIDI play/stop/location and data-path commands.

name: sndbase_bind_bank
comment: Command 0x9050+slot: load a bank into the hybrid synth. Slot 1 (mode bank) loads into port 0 as bank 1 beside the common bank; other slots load into the port of the same number as bank 0 (character banks: ports 2 and 3).

name: sndbase_set_port_parameter
comment: Command 0xA0+n: store the argument's two low bytes at offsets 0 and 1 of synth port n's 0x558-byte context at 0x6254.

name: sndbase_set_port_volume
comment: Command 0xB0+n: n 0 or 1 sets that synth port's volume; n 2..4 sets ports 2, 3 and 4 together. Port 1 aliases port 0.

name: sndbase_initialize
comment: Command 0x8010: create the sound thread, configure the MIDI and hybrid-synth modules, initialize both, and return MIDI input buffer 0x6008 for the common stream.

name: sndbase_midi_input_buffer
comment: Command 0x8100: return MIDI input buffer 0x6008/0x5E08/0x5C08/0x5A08 for port 0..3.

name: sndbase_configure_modules
comment: Set up four MIDI input buffers (0x6008, 0x5E08, 0x5C08, 0x5A08) and six hybrid-synth ports: ports 0 and 1 share input 0x5F08 and context 0x6254; ports 2..4 use inputs 0x5D08, 0x5B08, 0x5908 with contexts 0x6D04, 0x725C, 0x77B4.
